Stryker NCR._comment: NCR site 'Stryker Sector 59' (city NCR). Logics from the client sheet + the 10-day sample. Salad 1 = green salad daily (salad 2 follows rules); indian bread 1 = tawa roti daily (bread 2 follows rules — needs bread slot_count 2, see the config note); rice split: flavour rice Mon/Wed/Thu/Fri, white rice (const slot) Tue only, so flavour rice is blank whenever white rice runs. The 15-day cadences (fish/biryani/sambar) are now enforced across plans via selector_history_window rules that read saved history (paired with within-plan caps where relevant). Still deferred: 'serve a biryani day once/15 days' (positive cadence) and 'biryani not the same week as fish' (week co-occurrence) are not expressible yet; sambar needs the counter switched dal -> dal_sambar to serve it. 'Thursday special' needs the special defined; 'cut fruits' is a breakfast item.

rules._comment: Fish at most once a WEEK within a plan (the within-plan half of once-per-15-days).
rules.name: strykerncr_fish_max_1

rules._comment: Fish once per 15 DAYS, enforced across plans from saved history: a fish served in the last 15 days is banned until the window clears. Pairs with strykerncr_fish_max_1 (within-plan cap).
rules.name: strykerncr_fish_15d_window

rules._comment: Biryani (nonveg) at most once per 15 days across plans (history window). The sheet's 'serve a biryani day once/15 days' positive cadence and 'not the same week as fish' co-occurrence are not expressible yet and stay deferred; this enforces the cap half.
rules.name: strykerncr_biryani_15d_window

rules._comment: A sambar once per 15 days across plans (history window). Matches any sambar dish (course_type sambar — 10 were imported into NCR). Inert until this counter serves sambar (switch dal -> dal_sambar in the editor); then it caps the cadence.
rules.name: strykerncr_sambar_15d_window

rules._comment: Biryani not in the same WEEK as fish (site-specific, Stryker only). scope: week makes the two families mutually exclusive across the whole plan — if the week has a fish it has no biryani, and vice versa. Covers veg (rice) and non-veg (nonveg_main) biryani.
rules.name: strykerncr_fish_biryani_not_same_week

rules._comment: Flavour rice on the days white rice is not served: Mon/Wed/Thu/Fri.
rules.name: strykerncr_flavour_rice_no_tue

rules._comment: White rice (const steamed-rice slot) only on Tuesday; flavour rice is blank that day.
rules.name: strykerncr_white_rice_tue

rules._comment: Green salad is pinned daily in salad 1 (a multi-slot expansion, so the pin is a solved cell, not a whole-slot stamp). Mark it repeatable so unique_items allows the same dish every day.
rules.name: strykerncr_green_salad_repeatable

rules._comment: Tawa roti is pinned daily in bread 1 — repeatable so it may recur every day.
rules.name: strykerncr_tawa_roti_repeatable

Stryker NCR._config_note: This counter currently has bread slot_count 1. For 'indian bread 2 follows rules' (the second, non-tawa bread the sample shows), set bread to 2 in the editor. At count 1 the pin still holds — tawa roti every day — just with no second bread.
Stryker NCR._disable_comment: deep_fried_coupling (the Bangalore rice-bread/deep-fried family rule) conflicts with pinning bread 1 to tawa roti daily on this simple North-Indian counter; not relevant to NCR, so dropped.

constant_items._comment: salad 1 = green salad daily (salad 2 follows rules); indian bread 1 = tawa roti daily (bread 2 follows rules).
